title: Mass Assignment - Customer Role Manipulation via PATCH /api/v1/customers/:id
description: The PATCH /api/v1/customers/:id endpoint in the vulnerable API accepts a 'role' field in the request body through the updateCustomerSchema Zod schema. The schema includes 'role: z.string().optional()'. The handler extracts the role from the parsed data and passes it to the UpdateCustomer use case via the input object. This allows a CUSTOMER (who has access to this endpoint via vulnerableRequireRole) to update any customer's role to 'ADMIN', including their own or other customers' roles.
impact: Privilege escalation via customer update. A CUSTOMER can escalate their own role to ADMIN or modify other customers' roles to ADMIN, achieving full administrative access. Combined with IDOR (no ownership check), a customer can escalate any customer's role to ADMIN.
mitigation: 1) Remove 'role' field from updateCustomerSchema in vulnerable API. 2) Secure API's updateCustomerSchema already excludes 'role'. 3) The UpdateCustomer use case should not accept role changes from client input. 4) Role changes should only be possible via administrative interface with proper authorization checks.

history.details: Initial audit finding recorded for mass assignment of role in customer update
